QuestInfo.name: First Greeting with Camila, the Town Resident
QuestInfo.0: It looks like #p229#, the town clerk, is looking for someone to help with his work. Let's go check out #p235# in front of #m10001007#.
QuestInfo.1: #p229#, the town clerk, asked me to greet #b#p204##k, a resident of the town. Since I've become a resident here too, greeting the townspeople is a given, right?\r\n#rOnly characters at Level 12 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: I greeted #p204#, a resident of #m10001000#. I have a feeling we're going to get along great!

0.0: "Since you've become a resident of #m10001000#, it would be a good idea to go greet the people here. As it happens, I've been wondering how #p204# is doing lately, so please go say hello to #p204#.\r\n- #p229#"

1.0: Are you an adventurer? We have so many adventurers visiting our town every single day.
1.1: Oh, you're not an adventurer, but a resident here? Wow, that's absolutely wonderful! I'm so thrilled to have a new neighbor. I'm #p204#.
1.2: I truly love #m10001000#. The warm weather, the vast prairies, and most of all, being able to live in a cute mushroom house—I just adore it all. You'll fall in love with this town soon enough, too. Just you wait, hehe.

level.0: But you... your level seems a bit too low, doesn't it?
